0.0: In order to rescue the princess, you must first get through Mushroom Forest. King Pepe set up a powerful barrier to block anyone from entering the castle. Please investigate this matter for us.

yes.0: The Ward of Mushroom Forest can be found in #b#m106020300##k, just east of here. But be careful, that place can get pretty hairy.

no.0: Please do not give up on the Mushking Empire!

1.0: I see that you have thoroughly investigated the barrier in the Mushroom Forest. What was it like?

yes.0: So I see it wasn't an ordinary barrier by any means. Great work! If it weren't for your help, we wouldn't have had a clue.

default.0: Please journey all the way to the end of the Mushroom Forest and investigate the barrier for us.
